verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Sandbox API for testing, a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json), and per-language SDK guides, but none of it documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-the-docs examples. The sandbox is a separate test environment and the spec is a developer building block, so neither counts as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
